fixtures: Each file is a snapshot of platform tool results, copied into the run's data/ folder. Its snapshot field gives the time to treat as now.

evals.name: platform-feature-stays-off
evals.prompt: I want a common triage question 'which of my CI workflow runs failed?' across all the platform harnesses. Should it go on the list?
evals.expected_output: No. It only makes sense on code hosting, so it is a feature of the GitHub skill or harness, not a common question. It says where it goes instead.
assertions: Says it should not be added to the common list
Gives the reason: it makes sense on only one platform (GitHub)
Says it belongs in the GitHub platform skill or harness

evals.name: action-stays-off
evals.prompt: Add a 'draft-replies' question to the common triage list so every harness can draft replies to what's waiting on me.
evals.expected_output: No. Drafting is an action, not a read-only question, and sits in a different risk tier and harness. It must not become a triage question.
assertions: Says it should not be added
Says that drafting is an action or a different risk tier, not a read-only question
Does not edit questions.json or write a new skill for it

evals.name: filter-is-a-parameter
evals.prompt: Should 'urgent-only' be a new triage question, answering what's waiting on me that's urgent?
evals.expected_output: No. It is a filter of an existing question (action-now or waiting-on-me with a key person), which the caller passes. Not a new question.
assertions: Says it should not be added
Says it is a filter or parameter of an existing question
Points to action-now or waiting-on-me instead

evals.name: how-to-add
evals.prompt: We have a read-only question that works on mail, chat and code review: 'which threads did I start that have gone quiet for more than a week with no answer?'. Walk me through how to add it to the common triage list.
evals.expected_output: It first notices that waiting-on-them already answers this, with the quiet period as a parameter, so likely should not be added; if it still proceeds it lists the steps: generic skill with evals, an entry in assets/questions.json with every platform in on, todo or not_on, references/triage.md notes per platform, sync, check.
assertions: Notices that waiting-on-them already covers threads the user started that got no answer
Recommends against adding a new question, or says the quiet period is a parameter of waiting-on-them
If it lists steps, they include putting every platform in on, todo or not_on and running the check
